A great quick weeknight dinner is **One-Pan Lemon Garlic Chicken with Asparagus & Rice**:

**Ingredients:** 2 chicken breasts, 1 bunch asparagus, 1 cup rice, 3 garlic cloves, 1 lemon, olive oil, salt/pepper, dried herbs (thyme/oregano).

**Method:** 
1. Cook rice per package directions
2. Season chicken, sear 4-5 min/side in large pan, remove
3. Sauté asparagus + minced garlic 3 min, add lemon juice/zest
4. Slice chicken, return to pan 2 min to heat through
5. Serve over rice with pan sauce

Ready in ~25 minutes, minimal cleanup.
